additional_info.subject: RE: ID0373154-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002181] SECC Polling Error CRM:00643000847
additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. Upon checking the logs, I found out that the SECC LE lost communication with PLC, and this is causing the error. Please plan a site intervention to revive the charger by checking all the connections associated with SECC-LE. Please carry a spare LAN cable and EcoG-LE for the intervention. Can we have a call today in order to discuss more about the trouble shooting steps?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
